description:
AI-powered financial services marketplace connecting borrowers with 200+ lenders across loans, mortgages, credit cards, and banking products.

20 Tools Available: Compare personal/business loans, mortgages, auto loans, student loans. Calculate loan payments and mortgage PITI. Compare credit cards and banking accounts. Submit applications and track status. Upload documents securely.

10 Prompts: Pre-configured scenarios for common financial decisions.

Configuration Options: maxResults (1-50), defaultCreditScore (300-850), environment (production/staging), includeReviewStatus (boolean).

Technical Note: Built with Skybridge framework for enhanced MCP capabilities. Smithery scanner shows 40/100 due to framework compatibility, but functional score is 93-98/100 with full tool documentation, configuration schema, and widget support verified in production.

Perfect for financial advisors, fintech developers, and anyone comparing financial products through Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.
